notes:
What's new in 0.1.80:
• Fixed several security problems we found ourselves. Details are kept private.
• Home-network sign-in now has its own secure certificate that the phone app remembers.
• Parental controls: a stricter rating or a blocked title now stops a film that is already playing.
• Family viewing turned on mid-film now starts with the next film, not the one playing.
• Watch Together, Movie Night and Phone speakers say why someone had to leave.
• BeeboSchool: removing a child erases all of that child's data. Uploads are safer.
• Downloads only offer sizes that are really smaller than the original.
• Subtitles from a separate .srt or .vtt file can be burnt into the picture.
• Settings > Playback lists kept streaming copies, with Remove.
• Faster Movies page, rewind and seek.
• Posters show again when Beebo runs on a different port.
• Better contrast, TV remote support in the web pages, and an accessibility pass.
• Live TV: add your own playlist without a tuner.
• Movie info through Beebo's shared key only for approved accounts (none yet).
• The installer is not code-signed.
• Built from commit 08ad47f58, Oct 6, 2026, 11:05 AM Eastern.
